book.name: Matayo
book.title: Malobhi Manyahi ngati moghalembakike na Matayo

content: Yesu bhumpeleka kwaka Pilato
Pakwahiki lukela, bhapenganyambiku bhakolongwa, na bhazee bha bhandu bhakahimangini kulongela nahuli bhapata kunkoma Yesu.
Bhakunkongiki minyololu, bhakuntoliki na kumpeleka kwaka Pilato, nkolongwa wa Kiloma.
Yuda alikongela
Panihapa Yuda, jola joakang'anambwike, paakaweni kubha bhajomwi kuntemula Yesu, ukambiniki mtima namaa, akabhakelabhuki bhapenganyambiku bhakolongwa na bhazee ipandi selasini ya madini gha feza yela,
koni akapwagha, “Ndehi mahoku kwa kung'anambuka mundu jwanga na lihakau.” Nambu bhombi bhakayangike, “Bho, tepani tutenda kike? Leniheli umanya wamwete.”
Yuda akaileki ipandi ya madini gha feza yela pa Nyumba jaka Chapanga, akabokiki, na kujenda kulikongela.
Bhapenganyambiku bhakolongwa bhakaitoliki ipandi ya mbjija yela, na kupwagha, “Ngacheipalika kuibheka mu chikoku cha nyambiku, kwa ndandi nde mbija yeipatakini kwa kukoma.”
Bhela bhakajetanganili, na bhakaitumi kwa kuhemela ngonda wa lutopi, lubya pandu pa kubhataghi bhaghene.
Nde ndandi mbaka lalenu ngonda hoghu ulowakeka, “Ngonda wa mwahi.”
Panihapa nde ghakapitali malobhi ghaka mlota Yelemia, “Bhakaitoliki ipandi selasini ya mbija, malepu ghaka jola ambaju Bhaizilaeli bhakajetakili kulepa,
na kuitumila kwa kuhemela ngonda wa lutopi, ngati Bambo moakalaghalakile.”
Pilato andaluki Yesu
Yesu akajemiki palongi jaka nkolongwa wa ku Loma joakabhi nkolongwa wa mkoa. Bhela nkolongwa hoju akundalukile, “Bho, wehapa le unkolongwa wa Bhayahude?” Yesu akamuyangiki, “Wehapa upwaghike.”
Nambu bhapenganyambiku bhakolongwa papamu na bhazee, pabhakuntakile ngacheakayangiki lilobhi.
Panihapa Pilato akumpwaghile, “Bho, ngacheujowana mambu ghanihagha ghokapi ghabhukutaki nagho?”
Nambu Yesu ngacheakayangiki lilobhi hata limu, na nkolongwa wa ku Loma hoju akakangichi namaa.
Yesu atemulika kupotela
Bhela kila chikahi cha Uwangalalu wa Pasaka, nkolongwa wa Kiloma akabhi na ntetu wa kumbopulela mkongeka jumu jobhumpala bhandu.
Chikahi hechi akabhi mkongeka jumu joakamanyakini namaa, lihina laki Balaba.
Bhela pabhakalibhongini, Pilato akabhapwaghile, “Bho, mpala numbopulya nane? Numbopulya Balaba, au Yesu joalowakeka Kristo?”
Kwa ndandi akamanyiki kubha bhakundetiki Yesu kwaki kwa ndandi ja wihu wa bhakolongwa bha Bhayahude.

Chikahi Pilato paakatemi pachitehu chaki cha utemulu, nhwanu waki akumpelaki ubholu, na kumpwaghila, “Ngawikubha na lilobhi lokapi lela na mundu wambone. Kwa ndandi lalenu ng'ahakiki namaa mu ndoto kwa ndandi jaki.”
Bhapenganyambiku bhakolongwa papamu na bhazee bhakabhapwaghi lipogha la bhandu nahuli bhunjopa Balaba abhopuliwaje, na bhunkoma Yesu.
Pilato akabhalalukile, “Bho, mpala numbopulya nane pachilanda ja bhabheli abhabha?” Bhakayangiki, “Balaba.”
Pilato akabhalalukile, “Bho, henu nhenga kiki na Yesu joalowakeka Kristo?” Bhokapi bhakayangiki, “Unhwambaje punsalaba!”
Nambu Pilato akabhalalukile, “Bho, kwa ndandi ja kike? Bho, ahengiki lihoku bhole?” Nambu bhombi bhakajendali kujamalila, koni bhakapwaghaje, “Unhwambaje punsalaba!”

Bhela Pilato paakaweni kubha njeta chindu chengi cheaweza kutenda, na njobhela ijonjukeka, akatoliki machi, na kuchamba mabhoku ghaki palongi ja lipogha lokapi, koni akapwaghaje, “Nepani ngachemi na lihoku panani ja mwahi waka mundu ajoju wambone, mmanya mabhete!”
Bhandu bhokapi bhakayangiki, bhakapwaghaje, “Mwahi waki na ubya panani jitu, na panani ja bhana bhitu!”
Panihapa akabhabhopuli Balaba, na paakalaghalaki Yesu bhundapula iboku, akumbohiki nahuli awambakikaje punsalaba.
Manjolinjoli bhundongama Yesu
Panihapa manjolinjoli bhaka Pilato bhakumpeliki Yesu mu nyumba ja kikolongwa jaka Pilato, na kulibhongana manjolinjoli bhokapi kumuyongolota Yesu.
Bhakamuhuliki ingobhu yaki, na kumuwatika ingobhu jikeli ngati nkolongwa.
Bhakalokiki litaji la miha, bhakunhwatiki pamutu jaki, na kumbekela ndahi mu chiwoku chaki cha kumalelelu. Bhakachikimi palongi jaki, bhakundongimi, bhakapwaghaje, “Monile, Unkolongwa wa Bhayahude!”
Bhakunhuni imata, bhakautoliki ndahi ghola, na kundapula naghu pamutu.
Pabhakajomwi kundongama, bhakajihuliki ingobhu jela, bhakamuwatiki ingobhu jaki, na kumpeleka kumuwamba punsalaba.
Yesu awambakika punsalaba
Pabhakabhi bhajenda, bhakumbweni mundu jumu Mkilene, lihina laki Simoni. Jonihoju bhakuntwekiki msalaba waka Yesu kwa makili.
Pabhakahikiki pandu papalowakeka Goligota, ndandi jaki, Lifuvu la Mmutu,
bhakumpeki Yesu kunywa divai jejihangaghini na chindu chibhabha. Nambu jombi paakajionjiki, akakaniki kunywa.

Pabhakajomwi kunhwamba punsalaba, bhakaghabhini ingobhu yaki, kwa kuilapulila kula. Nahuli ghapitalya malobhi ghaakapwaghiki mlota waka Chapanga, “Bhakaghabhini ingobhu yangu ya kunja, na kanzu jangu ja mkati bhakajilapuli kula.”
Bhela bhakatemi pahi, koni bhakabya bhundenda.
Panani ja mmutu waki, punsalaba, bhakalembiki litakilu laki, “Ajoju nde Yesu, Nkolongwa wa Bhayahude.”
Chikahi chenihechi bhakongeka bhabheli bhanyaghula bhakawambakiki papamu na Yesu, jumu ku chiwoku chaki cha kumalelelu, na jongi ku chiwoku chaki cha kumangeja.
Bhandu bhabhakabhi bhapeta mwindela bhakuntondwile, koni bhakanyuha mimutu jabhu, na kupwagha.
“Wehapa, weupwaghika uweza kujiyonanga Nyumba jaka Chapanga na kuchenga kwa machobha ghatatu, ulikengalya wamwete. Ana ngati wehapa wa Mwana waka Chapanga, uhuluka punsalaba hapa!”
Bhelabhela, bhapenganyambiku bhakolongwa papamu na bhalemba bha Shelia na bhazee, bhakundongimi bhakapwaghaje,
“Akabhakengali bhangi, nambu ngacheaweza kulikengalela mweni. Ana ngati jombi nde Nkolongwa wa Izilaeli, ahuluka punsalaba, na tepanu anatunhobhalyaje!
Anhobhale Chapanga, na kupwagha eti jombi nde Mwana waka Chapanga, bhela Chapanga ankengalya sajenu, ngati anaampala.”
Bhanyaghula bhabhawambakiki papamu naku bhala, bhakuntondwi kwa indela jejeji.
Yesu apotela punsalaba
Kutumbu chikahi cha saa sita mbaka saa tisa, inchi jokapi jakabhi lwihi.
Ngati saa tisa, Yesu akajamalili sauti jaki kwa makili, akapwagha, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabakitani?” Ndandi jaki, “Chapanga wangu, Chapanga wangu, mbona unehile?”
Nambu bhandu bhakumu bhala bhabhakabhi bhajemani panihapa, pabhakajowini ghanihagha, bhakapwaghite, “Andoha Eliya!”
Jumu wabhu akakembili imbelu, akatoliki siponji, na kujitwelakela divai jejilolike, na kujibheka pandahi na kumpekeha akunywaje.
Bhandu bhangi bhakapwaghiki, “Lendalya, tulolaje ana ngati Eliya ahika kunkengalela!”
Yesu paakajamalili kabheti kwa sauti ngolongwa, akahekiti roho jaki.
Palapala lipazia la Nyumba jaka Chapanga likakachwiki ipandi ibhele, kutumbu kunani mbaka pahi. Ndema ukanyukike, na maganga ghakakajwike,
matengeli ghakahogwike, na hyegha yamaheli ya bhandu bhaka Chapanga bhabhakapotile bhakahyokite.
Bhabhakapitiki mumatengeli, paakajomwi Yesu kuhyoka, bhakapiti kujingila mu Muchi Uhuhu, na kubhonikana na bhandu bhamaheli.

Bhela nkolongwa wa manjolinjoli na bhala bhabhakabhi bhundenda Yesu, pabhakaweni kunyukanyuka kwa ndema, na mambu ghaghahengakike, bhakajowipi namaa, bhakapwaghaje, “Chakaka, mundu ajoju akabhi Mwana waka Chapanga!”
Pakabhi na akambomba bhamaheli panipala bhakalingalya cha kutali. Bhanihabha nde bhala bhabhunjengalya Yesu kuhuma ku Galilaya, na kuntumakila.
Papu akabhi Malia Magidalena, Malia mabhu waka Yakobo na Yusufu, na nhwanu waka Zebedayo.
Yesu ataghakika
Pakwahiki pakamihi, akahikiki mundu jumu mwana hindu yamaheli mwenei wa ku Alimataya, lihina laki Yusufu. Jonihoju najombi akabhi mbulwa waka Yesu.
Yusufu akapiti kwaka Pilato, na kunjopa ampekya hyegha jaka Yesu. Bhela Pilato akalaghalaki antolaje.
Yusufu akajitoliki hyegha jaka Yesu, na kujiyongalowa ingobhu jinyahi jihuhu,
na kujibheka hyegha mulitengeli laki Yusufu lahenu, leakabhi alilenganaki paliganga. Akahingali liganga likolongwa pandyangu wa litengeli, na mweni kubhoka.
Panipala akabhi Malia Magidalena, na Malia jongi jola, bhakabhi bhatemi palongi ja litengeli.
Kulenda litengeli
Chilabhu jaki, yani lichobha la kabheli baada ja Lichobha la Maandaliu gha Lichobha la Sabato, bhapenganyambiku bhakolongwa, na Mafalisayo bhakunjendi Pilato,
bhakapwaghike, “Nkolongwa, tukombwiki kubha mpuhi jola akapwaghike, ‘Paghipeta machobha ghatatu anahyokaje.’

Bhela ulaghalakya litengeli lilendakika wichu mbaka lichobha la katatu, ngabhihika bhabhulwa bhaki kunjibha, na kubhapwaghi bhandu kubha ahyokiki kuhuma kwa bhakuwa. Upuhi wa kujomukela anaupeta ghola wa kutumbula.”
Pilato akabhapwaghile, “Mbi na bhalenda, njendanya mkalilenda wichu ngati mommanyila.”
Bhakapiti, bhakalilendiki litengeli wichu, kwa kulijeghela liganga la pundyangu lela alama, na kubhabheka manjolinjoli bhalendaje.
